name: Dr. Miele Cosmed Group S.A.
summary: Dr. Miele Cosmed Group S.A., founded in 1990 and headquartered in Radom, Poland, is actively involved in the global production and distribution of a diverse array of chemical and cosmetic products. Their extensive portfolio includes personal hygiene items such as shower gels, liquid soaps, and sanitizing gels and sprays, alongside a dedicated range for children encompassing washing and care cosmetics, wet wipes, and laundry detergents. The company also manufactures household cleaning essentials, offering toilet cleaners, toilet blocks, drain openers (in granule and gel form), washing liquids, fabric softening concentrates, and specific agents for kitchen and bathroom cleaning, as well as hand and surface disinfectants. These offerings are prominently marketed under brands like Bobini, Apart, Biophen, Mole, Sofin, Izo, and Izozid. The company officially adopted its current name, Dr. Miele Cosmed Group S.A., in March 2024, having previously operated as Global Cosmed S.A.
